The CI validator reads these local files, validates each official Git blob SHA, 512 KiB size limit, original JSON Schema identifier and draft-07 metadata, and rejects missing or corrupt source copies. No schema updates or network fetches occur automatically. The source content integrity check is not a signed upstream release, full deployed-product SBOM or independent license review. Preserve the upstream notices and license when redistributing.
